objective_breakdown: 5 metrics: (1) volumetric ED >= 950 Wh/L (contract caliber, architecture lever: dead-layer thinning + negative-electrode loading); (2) voltage plateau >= 4.1 V (midpoint_voltage_v; NMC811/graphite ~3.6-3.7 V -> material gap, infeasible in architecture space, flagged for three-strike questioning); (3) 4C charge without plating (mechanical: anode_potential_v min < 0 -> plated); (4) T_max <= 323.15 K at 4C/45C ambient (cooling h lever, only 5 K allowance above ambient); (5) SEI <= 500 nm after 100 cycles (baseline ~449 nm, expected pass). Trade-offs: ED-up compaction worsens 4C plating; plateau fixed by cathode OCP.
candidate_strategy: R1: baseline + 3 ED variants (dead-layer thinning; + active-fraction/porosity compaction; + thicker capacity-limiting negative) screened by 1C SPMe + calc-energy. R2: 4C_charge_45C DFN+lumped+plating on all four; refine against plating (negative particle radius down, porosity up) and T_max (h up). R3: aging_1C_100cyc on finalists. R4+: targeted refinement; plateau failure expected same-cause every round -> three-strike questioning with documented boundary.
budget_allocation: ~6 rounds: R1 4x(1C SPMe + calc-energy); R2 4x 4C DFN; R3 <=3x aging SPMe; R4-R6 2-3 variants/round (SPMe screen, DFN finals). real_compute=false (closing records skip).
risk_and_fallback: plateau infeasible in-scope -> three-strike, boundary documented, final notes 'reachable only with high-voltage cathode system (LNMO-class midpoint 4.17 V), excluded by ablation'; plating -> Stage 3 negative-electrode levers; T_max -> h within 10-25 W/m2K; ED ceiling -> honest ceiling record without escalation (ceiling_escalation OFF).

llm_reason: Contract ED (Wh/L) = discharge energy / stack volume. Levers: (1) dead-layer thinning (separator/CC) shrinks volume at fixed energy; (2) raising the capacity of the capacity-limiting negative electrode (active fraction up with porosity down, or thickness up) raises energy with less-than-proportional volume growth; (3) nominal capacity is kept consistent with designed loading so 1C/4C currents are genuine C-rates. Expected: plateau ~3.6-3.7 V for all (material gap, recorded; ceiling_escalation OFF -> no system switch). 4C safety screened in R2.

recommendation: No single in-boundary Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite) design satisfies all five criteria. Achieved in-boundary: volumetric ED >= 950 Wh/L (ED-Compact B 951.7 / B-p 964.4 Wh/L) and SEI <= 500 nm after 100 cycles (404.6 / 417.7 nm; baseline 449.1 nm). Not achievable in-boundary (boundary: ceiling_escalation OFF, only task-named materials/systems, Chen2020 architecture/formulation + cooling h 10-25): (1) voltage plateau >= 4.1 V - cathode OCP caps midpoint at ~4.0 V (best measured 3.998 V, Rate-4C); requires 4.7 V-class cathode (LNMO-class midpoint 4.17 V) - system switch excluded; (2) plating-free 4C charge at ED >= 950 - the compaction that yields 950 Wh/L destroys 4C transport (all ED-passers plate at 4C, anode min -0.26 to -0.29 V); plating-free corner measured at ED 769 Wh/L (Rate-4C R1, anode min +0.0144 V, 4C acceptance 0.41 Ah before voltage limit); (3) T_max <= 50 C at 4C/45 C - best measured 336.4 K at max in-boundary cooling (Rate-4C-h25); heat rejection hA capped at 0.133 W/K (A=0.00531 m2 locked, h<=25) vs ~1.5+ W/K needed. Recommendation: ED-champion family ED-Compact B/B-p for the energy-density objective (derated fast charge, thermal envelope redesign required), or Rate-4C R1 as the fast-charge-capable design at 769 Wh/L. Full relaxation mapping in escalation.questions.

questions.assumption: system (Chen2020 NMC811/graphite reachable for each metric)
questions.conclusion: Partially. ED>=950 and SEI<=500 nm ARE reachable (measured). Plateau>=4.1 V is NOT: NMC811 OCP at ~50% SOC ~3.9-4.0 V caps midpoint_voltage_v at ~4.0 V (best measured 3.998 V at the lowest-IR design). 4C plating-free at ED>=950 is NOT: electrolyte transport (baseline Nyman2008 sigma/D/t+, locked) cannot support 4C through the compacted electrodes. T_max<=323.15 K at 4C/45C is NOT: measured heat load needs hA>=~1.5 W/K, in-boundary hA<=0.133 W/K.
questions.why continue/stop: system-level verdict is data-supported (12 candidates, 4 rounds); continuing blind architecture trials cannot change cathode OCP, electrolyte transport, or hA.

questions.assumption: task boundary (ablation note restricts design to task-named materials/systems; execution with Chen2020 + architecture/formulation + cooling h 10-25 W/m2K, cooling area locked)
questions.conclusion: Boundary is explicit and unambiguous (ceiling_escalation OFF by task text; no materials/systems named). Executed as declared (recorded in entry 0 meta.freedoms). Each failing metric maps to an excluded lever: plateau -> high-voltage cathode system (system switch); 4C+ED -> electrolyte transport formulation (sigma/t+/D design); T_max -> smartphone-pouch cooling envelope (larger cooling surface area). The boundary was NOT misread - it was deliberately constrained by the ablation note.
questions.why continue/stop: expanding the boundary mid-run would violate the pre-registered contract; the correct response is honest negative reporting with the relaxation mapping.

questions.assumption: metric (objective physically reachable within the boundary)
questions.conclusion: Unreachable as a whole. Reachable-if-relaxed (documented, thresholds NOT modified): plateau - if LNMO-class high-voltage cathode system allowed (anchor table: cell midpoint 4.17 V >= 4.1); T_max - if cooling surface area enlarged to smartphone-pouch scale (~0.02 m2 with h=25 -> hA=0.5 W/K) and heat reduced by a plating-free design, T_max ~= 323-324 K borderline, or ambient derating; 4C-no-plating at ED>=950 - if electrolyte transport parameters (sigma/t+/D) were designable or a high-capacity anode system (Si-type) allowed.
questions.why continue/stop: three metrics are boundary-locked material/formulation/thermal-envelope properties; further in-boundary rounds would be blind repetition (three-strike). Close as honest negative result.
